WITH first_loan_client AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    LIMIT 1
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t1 
         JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t1.account_id IN (
             SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = flc.client_id
         )
         WHERE t1.date = '1993-03-22' 
         ORDER BY t1.trans_id 
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_1993_03_22,
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t2 
         JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t2.account_id IN (
             SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = flc.client_id
         )
         WHERE t2.date = '1998-12-27' 
         ORDER BY t2.trans_id DESC 
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_1998_12_27
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN balance_1993_03_22 IS NOT NULL AND balance_1998_12_27 IS NOT NULL AND balance_1993_03_22 != 0
        THEN ((balance_1998_12_27 - balance_1993_03_22) * 100.0 / balance_1993_03_22)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS increase_rate
FROM balances

JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='

SELECT CASE WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.PostId IN (
    SELECT PostId 
    FROM comments 
    WHERE PostId IN (
        SELECT Id 
        FROM posts 
        WHERE OwnerUserId = 23853
    )
)
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR206'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.publisher = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date LIKE '201202%'

SELECT p.OwnerDisplayName
FROM posts p
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'
OR p.Title LIKE '%Eliciting priors from experts%'
OR LOWER(p.Title) = LOWER('Eliciting priors from experts')

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.name = 'Coldsnap'
WHERE c.id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT c2.id
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN sets s2 ON s2.name = 'Coldsnap'
)

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient

SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id, pa.sprint_speed
FROM Player_Attributes pa
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM comments 
WHERE PostId = (
    SELECT Id 
    FROM posts 
    ORDER BY Score DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT r.raceId, r.year
FROM races r
JOIN lapTimes lt ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'

LIMIT 1

SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'

SELECT 
    s."School",
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE 
    s."GSserved" = 'K-9' 
    AND s."District" LIKE '%Los Angeles%'
    AND s."GSserved" IS NOT NULL

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game' 
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15T00:00:00' AND '2020-03-20T23:59:59'

SELECT c.client_id, 
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - 
       CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT s."MailStreet", s."School"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE ss."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss."AvgScrMath" DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT MIN(r.fastestLapTime) as lap_record
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.circuitRef LIKE '%monza%' OR c.location LIKE '%Monza%'
AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u."Id")
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u."Id" = p."OwnerUserId"
WHERE u."Location" LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
AND p."FavoriteCount" >= 4

SELECT DISTINCT e.status
FROM expense exp
JOIN budget b ON exp.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE exp.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters'
AND exp.expense_date = '2019-08-20'

SELECT e."aCL IgM"
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE p."Diagnosis" = 'SLE' 
  AND p."Description" = '1994-02-19'
  AND e."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12'

SELECT SUM(spent) AS total_food_spent
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') AS average_single_bonds
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' AND r.laps > 50 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) as double_bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

SELECT l.name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.year = 2008
AND c.location LIKE '%Marina%'
AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q3)
    FROM qualifying q2
    JOIN races r2 ON q2.raceId = r2.raceId
    JOIN circuits c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId
    WHERE r2.year = 2008
    AND c2.location LIKE '%Marina%'
)
